//: Production build config for the API. Unlike tsconfig.json (used by ts-node in dev), this drops the `paths` aliases so `lowcode-server` / `lowcode-dev-proxy` resolve to their COMPILED packages (packages/*/lib) from node_modules. That keeps the package sources out of the program, so rootDir stays at src/api and the emitted dist mirrors the source tree (dist/src/api/<pkg>/...).
